table.name: Has_Pet
table.purpose: Junction/ownership table linking students to their pets: each row records that a student (StuID) owns a pet (PetID). The composite (StuID, PetID) likely forms the primary key; PetID is unique per row here, but the many_to_one join on StuID shows students can own multiple pets.

PetID.name: PetID
PetID.description: Foreign key to Pets.PetID identifying the pet owned by the student; lookup shows pet types (cat, dog).

StuID.name: StuID
StuID.description: Foreign key to Student.StuID identifying the student who owns the pet; a student can own multiple pets.

table.name: Pets
table.purpose: A small lookup/registry table of pets, one row per pet, with its type, age, and weight. Linked to students via the Has_Pet join table (many-to-many between Student and Pets).

PetID.name: PetID
PetID.description: Primary key of the Pets table; unique identifier for each pet. Referenced by Has_Pet.PetID, which links pets to students.

PetType.name: PetType
PetType.description: Species of the pet, e.g. 'dog' or 'cat'.

pet_age.name: pet_age
pet_age.description: Age of the pet, most likely in whole years (values 1-3).

weight.name: weight
weight.description: Body weight of the pet, plausibly in kilograms (values 9.3-13.4); unit not confirmed by the data.

table.name: Student
table.purpose: One row per student: identity (first/last name, sex, age), major code, advisor ID, home city code, and a unique student ID used to link to pet ownership via the Has_Pet table.

Advisor.name: Advisor
Advisor.description: Identifier of the student's academic advisor (faculty/advisor ID). No join to another table is present, so the referenced entity table is not in this database; the values are opaque numeric IDs.

Age.name: Age
Age.description: Student's age in years (range 16-27, typical college ages).

Major.name: Major
Major.description: Code identifying the student's major/degree program (e.g. 600, 550, 540). No lookup table for these codes exists in the database, so the specific meanings of the codes are unresolved.

StuID.name: StuID
StuID.description: Student ID; primary key of the table. Referenced by Has_Pet.StuID (a student can own multiple pets).

city_code.name: city_code
city_code.description: Three-letter code for the student's home city (e.g. NYC = New York, CHI = Chicago, PIT = Pittsburgh, PHL = Philadelphia, HKG = Hong Kong). No lookup table present, so exact city mapping is inferred from common airport/city codes.
